observations: Blue painted industrial gear reducer with a yellow output shaft.
The unit has a flanged input end and a mounting bracket with four bolt holes.
The housing appears to be made of cast iron.
No brand name, model number, or technical specifications are visible on the exterior.
Watermark 'IFABROS INDUSTRIAL POSTED ON JIJI' is present on all photos.

claims.evidence: The capacity and material are not visible on the exterior.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The unit may be a used or refurbished unit rather than a new one.
risks.proof: A photo of the original manufacturer's label or a technical specification sheet.

risks.risk: The internal gears may be worn or damaged.
risks.proof: A video of the unit running and the sound of the gears.

risks.risk: The output shaft may be damaged or stripped.
risks.proof: A photo of the shaft end and a video of it being turned.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's label or technical specification plate.
Video of the unit powered on and running.
Photo of the output shaft end.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
